topic: Making room for grief at Christmas (companion Reel, off grid, video experiment)
caption:
Missing someone can feel sharpest at Christmas.

The holidays are built from memory, so an absence can be felt more now. Across many cultures, rituals may help people keep a continuing bond with the person who died, through small acts like a candle, their name said out loud or a favourite dish. There is no right way to do this season.
